Global Renewable Energy Adoption Reaches New Record in 2025

By Dr. Sarah Jenkins | Published November 14, 2025

Global installations of solar photovoltaic and offshore wind systems expanded by 24% over the prior fiscal year, according to newly published datasets from the International Energy Agency.

Researchers analyzed grid interconnect queues across North America, Europe, and East Asia. "The acceleration is primarily driven by plummeting battery storage costs and standardized permitting," said lead analyst Marcus Vance at the Stockholm Energy Institute.

However, significant infrastructure challenges remain. Transmission line congestion and rare earth mineral supply chains could constrain expansion if grid modernizations lag, according to independent grid operators surveyed in the study.
